name: Aurelia
description: Aurelia is an angel and the guildmaster, or warleader, of the Boros Legion on Ravnica.

summary.text: Aurelia is an angel and the guildmaster, or warleader, of the Boros Legion on Ravnica.

bio.text: Boros soldiers and a goblin worker say that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master of the guild, and she is cast as seeking to replace and banish him.

citations.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

bio.text: As guildmaster she is among the guild representatives gathered for the plan to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, in a ritual led by Nissa.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

bio.text: When the Karlov Manor killings begin, she demands that the Boros take over the investigation and declares that the Legion will do so while Agency detectives argue.

bio.text: She drags in Massacre Girl, who attacked her and killed ten Boros guards, declares the Cult of Rakdos is behind the killings, and grants Kaya twenty-four hours after Agrus Kos backs Kaya's plea.

citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

status.text: As of the latest story she is alive and leads the Boros Legion, having been freed from the branches and having taken Krenko off to be arrested.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace collaborates with Niv-Mizzet, Gideon allies with Aurelia, and the Implicit Maze makes Jace the Living Guildpact with Lavinia as manager.
timeline.quote: The Implicit Maze moved Jace into the central Living Guildpact role

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
timeline.quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros, arguing a disgraced angel cannot command respect.
timeline.quote: Feather was later replaced by one of these Angels, Aurelia

citation.text: "Angel", section "Firemane angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Discontented Boros gather under the war-leader Aurelia, who argues that no disgraced angel should lead them.
timeline.quote: gathered under the war-leader Aurelia, who argued that no disgraced angel should lead the Boros

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The Interregnum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ravnica Gideon accepts command of Boros soldiers from Aurelia but refuses membership.
timeline.quote: accepted command of the soldiers, shirking her offer of membership

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia tells Gideon Jura he must first fight among the rank and file so she can discern his skills.
timeline.quote: First, you must fight among the rank and file.

citation.text: Boros Elite (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, ending the Warmind Initiative collaboration between Boros and Izzet.
timeline.quote: Before Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, the two guilds had collaborated on the Warmind Initiative

citation.text: Warmind Infantry (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon is escorted into the Boros war room and feels Aurelia's overwhelming angelic aura.
timeline.quote: her aura was an order of magnitude higher than any he had encountered

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia says she has heard Gideon saved a Boros brigade from a Rakdos ambush.
timeline.quote: I have word that you saved an entire brigade of my Boros from a Rakdos ambush that would have killed every last one of them.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia shows Gideon the contested Ninth on her war table and explains how the guilds fight over it.
timeline.quote: The Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear it apart like a dromad's corpse

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia recounts that after the Guildpact broke the Azorius abandoned the Ninth and it was largely lost, under a disgraced earlier Boros leader.
timeline.quote: in the aftermath, the Azorius had to abandon the Ninth so they could rebuild New Prahv.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia reveals the Boros were once led by a disgrace to the Legion, which forced a change in guild leadership.
timeline.quote: We were led by a disgrace to the Legion.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia takes Gideon to a balcony overlooking Boros armies training and says she wishes to cleanse the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Ninth is a stain on Ravnica, a stain on the Boros, and a stain on my soul.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia offers Gideon command of a battalion, whether or not he joins the Boros.
timeline.quote: I am prepared to give you command of that battalion, there, if you will fight with us.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon accepts, resolving to wield Boros weapons for the greater good without becoming Boros, and asks when they start.
timeline.quote: He was not ready to become Boros.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura challenges Aurelia, saying scores will die in the name of peace.
timeline.quote: Scores will die in the name of peace.

citation.text: Renounce the Guilds (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tajic scouts with a platoon, linking with Orzhov patrols that, through Teysa Karlov, helped root out Dimir sleeper cells; the Obzedat agree to shared protection of the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia thanks Gideon and asks him to join the Boros; he declines because he is needed elsewhere.
timeline.quote: I am needed elsewhere. There are other battles I must fight.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia tells Gideon he is always welcome at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: You are always welcome at Sunhome, Jura.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Tajic angrily lists attacks on Boros to Aurelia and doubts her talk of peace.
timeline.quote: Three daggers left in an angel's back

citation.text: Nightveil Predator (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia urges troops to fight for Sunhome with the truth in their hearts.
timeline.quote: You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart.

citation.text: Gird for Battle (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Several angels leave the Boros after Aurelia's assaults to protect the guildless.
timeline.quote: several angels left the Boros and dedicated themselves to the protection of the guildless

citation.text: "Angel", section "Unguilded angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros.
timeline.quote: Aurelia ascended to the leadership of the Boros

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Replacing Feather". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia asks Gideon to cleanse the Ninth District and invites him to join the Legion.
timeline.quote: she asked him to cleanse the Ninth District of Ravnica, inviting him to join the Legion

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Meeting Gideon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia attends the guild summit and sees it dissolve after Isperia's murder, then joins Ral's alliance.
timeline.quote: She witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Guild Summit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia becomes guildmaster and reforms the guild, encouraging angels to mingle with lower ranks.
timeline.quote: After Aurelia assumed the office of guildmaster, she established several changes to the way the guild was run.

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia splits the legion into four theatres to deal with threats to public order.
timeline.quote: Aurelia has split leadership of the bulk of the legion into four

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko breaks the detention sphere holding an angel, plucks two feathers and falsely blames her escape before fleeing.
timeline.quote: He broke the sphere, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia demands justice if peace cannot be had.
timeline.quote: If we cannot have peace, we will have justice.

citation.text: Angelic Exaltation (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads ground units against God-Eternal Rhonas while Gideon and Aurelia lead the air, and after Gideon kills Rhonas, Angrath leads a charge that forces Bolas's forces back.
timeline.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas, Angrath was able to lead a successful charge against the remaining Eternals

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia is a general against the Dreadhorde and represents the Boros at Niv-Mizzet's resurrection.
timeline.quote: Aurelia was one of the generals of the forces fighting Bolas 's Dreadhorde

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia mourns Gideon's death.
timeline.quote: displayed much sorrow over Gideon's death

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia and the Boros fight in the vanguard against Nicol Bolas in the War of the Spark.
timeline.quote: Aurelia and the Boros Legion were in the vanguard of the troops fighting Nicol Bolas in the War of the Spark

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon is trapped on Ravnica by the Immortal Sun and fights the Dreadhorde with the Boros.
timeline.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Gideon, Aurelia and Angrath lead a force against God-Eternal Rhonas.
timeline.quote: led a massive force of planeswalkers and Boros, Izzet, and Simic troops into battle against the God-Eternal Rhonas

citation.text: "Huatli", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
timeline.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
timeline.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Boros airships and sky forces arrive and Gideon rides a pegasus toward Bolas.
timeline.quote: He was wielding the sword that could bring an end to all this—by bringing an end to Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.
timeline.quote: wrapped Mister Jura's armor in the leaves

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Aurelia tries to arrest Ral, Kaya and Vraska; Vraska challenges and assassinates her.
timeline.quote: The assassination was confirmed successful in a later issue

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Boom comics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia meets the Phyrexian invasion head-on.
timeline.quote: Aurelia met the Phyrexian invasion head-on

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As frontline fighters against the New Phyrexian Invasion the Boros suffer heavy losses and a crisis of faith; Aurelia takes the losses hard.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Aurelia took the losses particularly hard.

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir insists that Lazav is not dead and is planning something.
timeline.quote: It's naive to think that Lazav is dead.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Aurelia demands the Boros take over the investigation, provoking a scoff from Kellan.
timeline.quote: This investigation should be in the hands of the Boros.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Aurelia reports that Ezrim's people are locking down the building.
timeline.quote: Vannifar is coming, and Ezrim's people are locking down the building.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia declares the Legion will take over the investigation while Agency detectives argue.
timeline.quote: The Legion will take over from here.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The Agency and Azorius search the sealed crime scene.
timeline.quote: Barrier wards had been deployed inside the scene

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Aurelia are questioned in a verity circle and Kaya withholds Judith's name.
timeline.quote: Had either of them killed her? No.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft enters the crime scene and introduces himself as the great detective.
timeline.quote: I'm Alquist Proft.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion has asked me to work alongside the Agency doing whatever they feel is necessary to catch the party or parties responsible.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia drags in Massacre Girl, who attacked her and killed ten Boros guards.
timeline.quote: She killed ten of my guards before I stopped her.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia declares the Cult of Rakdos is behind the killings and prepares to march.
timeline.quote: her presence proves the Cult of Rakdos is behind all this senseless slaughter.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos backs Kaya's plea and Aurelia grants twenty-four hours.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four hours, no more, and the assassin stays with us

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia storms in and declares the Boros Legion at war with the Rakdos Cult.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion marches to war.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia confronts Kaya at the gathering with Massacre Girl chained beside her.
timeline.quote: Aurelia was the first to move, rising with a flurry of feathers from the leather armchair she'd been occupying

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba accuses Krenko of hoarding and price-gouging during the invasion.
timeline.quote: was hoarding resources

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia attempts to arrest Oba, who points out her sisters cannot be held responsible.
timeline.quote: I formally place you, Oba of Selesnya, under arrest.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba shakes the room and knocks Aurelia and Proft down.
timeline.quote: The room shook, not hard, but hard enough to drop Aurelia back to her seat and Detective Proft to the floor.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl slips her chain and disappears.
timeline.quote: all at once, the assassin was nowhere to be found.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees the guild leaders; Aurelia drags Krenko off to be arrested.
timeline.quote: all save Krenko, who found himself dragged along by a furious Aurelia determined to see someone arrested

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: After an attempt on her life, Aurelia gives the Agency a day to solve the case or the Boros will declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.
timeline.quote: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.

citation.text: Demand Answers (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia musters the Boros Legion as Kaya and Kellan race to prevent a guild war.
timeline.quote: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.

citation.text: Warleader's Call (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Karlov Manor case Kos is trapped in a crystal skull by Judith and left there.
timeline.quote: he was trapped in a crystal skull by Judith

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Karlov Manor Zegana is assassinated and Massacre Girl attempts Aurelia's life; Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos win time to investigate.
